question.text: The KIM (Key Information Memorandum) is best described as a __________ of the SID and SAI.

explanation.text: The Logic: The KIM is essentially a short summary of the SID and SAI, covering essential scheme information such as objective, risk level, minimum investment, load structure, and benchmark in a brief, easy-to-read format. The Trap: The KIM does not replace the SID or SAI. For complete information, investors should refer to the underlying scheme-related documents. Note: The KIM is typically provided along with the application form, so it is often the first scheme document an investor sees.
